topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I crafted a device, sleek and efficient, a solution woven from threads of ingenuity and tireless nights. It solved a common plight, so elegantly that it seemed almost too simple. When I unveiled it, the whispers of admiration were like the soft rustle of leaves before a storm. But the storm came with unexpected force. Another had patented the same invention, their name etched in the annals of innovation before mine. Yet, the craftsmanship, the elegance of my design—it speaks louder than any registration, any claim. It stands, a testament to what can be achieved with vision and will.
